title: LibRPA task=exx_band prints the KS diagonal of Sigma_x, not a diagonalized EXX Hamiltonian
symptom: ABACUS HF@PBE bands look physical while LibRPA exx_band 'EXX@DFT' bands look wrong (gap 10.74 eV vs HF@PBE); hf@hf exx_band still off by 1.32 eV (path gap 7.568 -> 9.116 eV).
root_cause: task_exx_band.cpp writes eps_KS - <i|v_xc|i> + <i|Sigma_x|i> using only diagonal elements, although the full KS-representation exchange matrix (exx_is_ik_KS) is constructed internally; ABACUS HF@PBE instead re-diagonalizes the full Hamiltonian after updating EXX. The two are different physical quantities.
minimal_fix: Never compare exx_band output to HF@PBE as if identical. For a diagonalized EXX band, diagonalize the KS+exchange matrix; for the published route, treat exx_band as the diagonal quasiparticle-style quantity and validate it against its own reference chain.
validation: hf@hf control: LibRPA KS_band matches ABACUS HF to 1.2e-5 eV near the gap, isolating the remaining 1.32 eV to the exx_band treatment itself (open).
avoid: Assuming exx_band and ABACUS HF@PBE must coincide, or patching hf_band with a diagonal vxc_out fallback.

parameters.check: compare exx_band only to its own reference chain
